paite: Chidam ludam a na om ua, na hong tam semsem ua, nou hon pe dia na pi-le-pute uh kiang a TOUPA'N akichiamna gam na va luahtheihna ding un ka hon thupiak tengteng zui ding in pilvang un.
heading: Luah Ding Gam Hoih
english: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers.

paite: Athupiakte na zui ding uhia, zui lou ding, na lungsim uh theihna dia enchian ding leh hon hihgim dia gamdai a kum sawmli sung nou ahon pina lampi tengteng theigige un.
english: You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.

paite: Tanghou kia in mihing ahing kei. TOUPA kam a thu chih pawt in ahing zaw, chih nou ahon theihsak theihna ding in hon hihgim a, na kial uh aphal a, na theih ngei louh uh, na pi-le-pute un leng atheih ngei louh uh manna in ahon vak hi.
english: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.

paite: Hiai kum sawmli sung in na puansilhte uh na silhtul kei ua, na khete uh leng abawk kei hi.
english: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.

paite: Mi'n ata asawi bang in TOUPA na Pathian un nou hon sawi ahi, chih na lungsim un thei un.
english: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.

paite: Alampi zui dia amah laudan siam ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zui ding uh ahi.
english: You shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un phaizangte leh mualte a pan hong pawtkhia luitui, tuikhuk leh tui thukpi omna gam;
english: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;

paite: buh, barli buh, grep, theipi leh theibuhfaite omna gam; thau nei olive leh khuaizu omna gam;
english: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;

paite: kitatlak lou a tanghou na nekna ding gam uh, bangmah na taksaplouhna ding uh, asuangte bang sik, atangte dal laihkhiak theihna gam hoih mahmah ah nou hon pilut ding ahi ngal a.
english: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

paite: Na neih ua, na tai mahmah chiang un, gam hoih mahmah ahon piak ziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh na phat ding uh ahi.
english: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.

paite: Athupiakte, adan thusehte leh adante, tuni a ka hon piak zui lou in TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh kha mahmah ding uh, pilvang un.
heading: TOUPA Mangngilh Lou Dia Vauhilhna
english: Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;

paite: Huchi lou in zaw na nek ua, na tai ua, inn hoih taktak na lam ua, na luah chiang un;
english: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;

paite: na ganhon uh, na belamhon uh ahong tam a, na dangka uh, na dangka-eng uh ahong tam a, na thil neih tengteng uh ahong tam hun chiang in na lungtang uh akisathei kha dia,
english: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;

paite: Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan noute hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh mai kha ding uh,
english: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

paite: Ama'n gamdai zatak leh lauhuaitak, gul gukhahte leh aikamte omna, tui omlouhna, gamkeu ah hon pi paisuak a;
english: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;

paite: suangpi a pan meisah suang tui ahon pawtkhesak a, na pi-le-pute uh theih ngei louh, manna in nou ahon vak a, tunung chiang khualna a na hoihtheihna ding un nou hon hihgim a, ahon chet theihna ding in.
english: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;

paite: "Hiai i sum-le-paite eimah hatna leh i khut hatna in asepkhiak ahi," na lungtang un na chi kha ding uh, pilvang un.
english: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”

paite: Tua na kip bang ua na pi-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a thu akhun ahihkipna ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh theigige un, sum-le-pai muhkhiak theihna hon pepa lah amah ahi ngal a.
english: But you shall remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh ua, pathian dangte na zuih ua, a-nna uh na sep ua, na biak uleh, na mangthang ngeingei ding uh, chih tuni in ka hon theisak ahi.
english: It shall be, if you shall forget Yahweh your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

paite: Na ma ua namdangte ahihmanthat bang in noute leng na mangthang ding uh, TOUPA na Pathian aw ngaikhe ut lou na hih ding ziak un.
english: As the nations that Yahweh makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
